reviews.text: Terrible experience. Very unprofessional and presumptuous! Strongly not recommended.
Impeccable care and attention for our four-legged friends!

What's the best thing about the daycare center? Seeing my Ketty, after driving 40km to the daycare center, start to tremble as soon as we turn off the exit, happy as can be. When we get there, she gets out of the car and walks toward the gate, eager to go in. So if she does that, I'd say 5 stars are really not enough. She's happy, she feels loved, calm, and having fun, and I'm calm too. It's a clean place, all the dogs are free to roam, but they're well looked after, and everyone is taken care of. Highly recommended.
Our experience has been positive, the dogs are happy to be there, you can see it! I feel comfortable leaving my golden there, sure that he will have fun and be happy, I definitely recommend it.

Cico&Co is a wonderful place where our Janet can have fun in the company of other friendly dogs and have complete freedom to roam and rest, under the watchful care of Matteo, a competent and attentive manager. We feel very comfortable leaving her at this daycare! Thank you, Matteo! 🐕 🐶 …
Today we visited Asilo per Cani Roma for the first time, and to be honest, I wish I could have stayed too! Welcoming, professional, and passionate! That's what we felt, and tomorrow...we'll be back!
Incredible experience! I came back after years, and as always, Matteo and his team are a guarantee.
We've been bringing our Scotch for about a year! The staff is knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. Scotch is always happy to come in! Highly recommended.

A wonderful place to leave our beloved furry friends. They can roam freely thanks to the owners' attentive care. Care is also taken in selecting the dogs to maintain a pleasant and peaceful environment. We always leave our dog, Funny, feeling safe and confident that she'll spend her days outdoors in the fresh air and in good company... let's just say she's having a wonderful holiday too!

I've been taking my two Maltesers, Penny and her inseparable little sister, to Cico dog daycare for a while now, and I couldn't be happier with my choice.
As soon as we arrive, they wag their tails so hard they seem to want to run inside on their own: for me, that alone is the best guarantee of how happy they are.

The staff is wonderful: attentive, affectionate, and knowledgeable. My little ones are pampered, allowed to play safely, and socialize with other four-legged friends. They go home calm, clean, and happy... and often so tired from play that they sleep like little angels at night.

The environment is clean, organized, and above all, you can feel a true love for animals.
I recommend Cico to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and professional place where their dog can feel at home... or maybe even better!
Maybe there must be a mistake! We don't know if she's been to us, but if so, she could give us some motivation to help us improve.

Welcoming daycare with lots of green space and knowledgeable staff.
I dropped off my dog ​​twice and had a great time.
Highly recommended.
I discovered this beautiful and well-kept place 3 years ago. Matteo takes care of furry children with dedication, professionalism, and passion. Highly recommended!
It's the only place I can leave Abel with peace of mind. Matteo & Co. are amazing. Our friends are safe. Thanks also for the support.
It is a beautiful place where dogs are free to play and run, always supervised by competent staff.
A place where dogs have plenty of space to socialize and for the more timid ones to be on their own.
